Lemma
[Gram--Schmidt Preserves Orientation]

If $b=(b_1,\ldots ,b_n)$ is a basis of an $n$-dimensional real inner product space, its Gram--Schmidt orthonormalization has the same orientation.

Proof

\sketch Let $u_i$ be the unnormalized Gram–Schmidt vectors and $\widehat u_i=u_i/|u_i|$. The change-of-basis matrix is triangular with determinant $\prod _i\langle \widehat u_i,b_i\rangle =\prod _i|u_i|>0$, since $\langle u_i,b_i\rangle =|u_i|^2$. Thus the orientation is unchanged.

□
